content.text:
Set up an ICE table. If x M of H₂ reacts, then at equilibrium [H₂] = [I₂] = 1.2 − x and [HI] = 2x.

K_c = (2x)² / (1.2 − x)² = 49

Take the square root of both sides: 2x / (1.2 − x) = 7
2x = 8.4 − 7x
9x = 8.4
x = 0.933 M

So [HI] = 2x = 1.87 M.

Check: [H₂] = [I₂] = 0.267 M, and (1.87)² / (0.267)² ≈ 49. ✓

The trap is choice 0 (0.933 M). That is x, not the HI concentration.

answers.brief_reasoning: Square root of K gives 2x/(1.2−x)=7, so x=0.933 M and [HI]=2x=1.87 M.
